headline: Dow rebounds to profit on pricing gains and cost cuts
summary_short: Revenue was $12.09B, up 19.7% y/y and 23.5% q/q, as Dow swung to net income of $721M from an $835M loss a year ago on higher polyethylene prices and self-help cost cuts.
summary_long: Revenue of $12.09B (+19.7% y/y, +23.5% q/q) was driven by a 20% y/y rise in local price — mainly higher polyethylene prices in Packaging & Specialty Plastics — which more than offset a 1% volume decline from planned maintenance. Operating EBIT (non-GAAP) rose to $1.6B from a $21M loss, and net income swung to $721M from an $835M loss, helped by Transform to Outperform savings running ahead of plan. GAAP EPS of $0.99 trailed operating EPS of $1.44 by $0.45, mostly Transform to Outperform restructuring/SG&A charges, partly offset by a Nova Chemicals-related tax benefit. Cash was $4.0B at quarter-end, up from $3.8B at 2025 year-end. Dow raised its 2026 self-help target by ~$200M to over $1.3B.

drivers.explanation: Local price rose 20% y/y, mainly higher polyethylene prices in Packaging & Specialty Plastics across all regions; volume fell 1% on planned maintenance activity.
Expansion tracked the same price gains as revenue against roughly flat cost of sales, per the release's segment price/volume/currency breakout.
Operating EBIT gain driven by higher prices plus Transform to Outperform self-help initiatives, which delivered ahead of plan this quarter.
Swing to profit reflects higher polyethylene and olefins prices and self-help savings, partly offset by $605M of pretax Transform to Outperform and restructuring charges.
GAAP EPS of $0.99 was $0.45 below operating EPS of $1.44, mainly Transform to Outperform restructuring/SG&A costs, partly offset by a tax benefit tied to a Nova Chemicals payment.

CEO Karen Carter said self-help initiatives "delivered ahead of plan," and Dow now expects ~$200 million more in Transform to Outperform benefits this year, raising the in-year self-help target to over $1.3 billion.
